title: chat view
content:
# Use the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %} The {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %} runs agents beside your code in the main {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} window. Use it when you want to collaborate over code in the current workspace while keeping the editor, debugger, tests, terminals, extensions, and notebooks available alongside the conversation. Start with a question about your project, ask for a change when you're ready, and inspect the result alongside your code. This article shows how to start a session, work with the agent, and arrange chat around your editor. To compare this approach with coordinating tasks in the [{% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}](/docs/agents/run/agents-window.md), see [Choose how you work](/docs/agents/overview.md#choose-how-you-work).
Follow a hands-on tutorial to build an app with AI agents in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. * [Start agentic coding tutorial](/docs/agents/agents-tutorial.md)
